title: Two restarts that run at once, and a command that says done before it starts

AC1.note: utils/restart-lease.ts staged write + linkSync; test 'of many takers at the same instant, exactly one wins'

AC2.note: heldMessage(); test 'a refusal says what to wait for'

AC3.note: LEASE_EXPIRY_MS + broke reporting; test 'a stale one is broken, and the break is reported'

AC4.note: test 'a live one is not broken, however impatient the next press is'

AC5.note: releaseRestartLease(); tests 'the next take succeeds immediately' and 'releasing what was never held is not an error'

AC6.note: claimRestart() in scripts/admin-daemon.ts guards all three cases; lease keyed on the lease file, not the command name

AC7.note: deferred flag keeps the row processing; restart-finish.ts closes it; system.ts duplicate check bounded by LEASE_EXPIRY_MS

AC8.note: scripts/host-ingress.ts execute() takes the same file lease; guard needs no database

AC9.note: 1881 pass 0 fail locally; tsc clean; CI test job green on aa748d2; 14 tests in tests/unit/restart-lease.test.ts against a real temp dir
